productsAndServices.description: A bidirectional integration between GitHub and Slack that creates ephemeral Slack channels for each pull request to centralize code review discussions and notifications.
productsAndServices.name: Axolo GitHub Slack Integration

productsAndServices.description: A Slack notification system that delivers GitLab CI/CD pipeline and deployment updates directly to Slack channels associated with merge requests.
productsAndServices.name: Axolo GitLab Actions Slack Notification

productsAndServices.description: A synchronization tool that mirrors comments and updates between GitHub and Slack, enabling seamless two-way communication on code reviews.
productsAndServices.name: Axolo Two-Way Sync Between Slack & GitHub

productsAndServices.description: A feature that creates dedicated Slack channels for each pull request and sends automated reminders to ensure timely code reviews and reduce merge delays.
productsAndServices.name: Axolo Pull Request Channels and Automated Reminders

productsAndServices.description: A configurable notification system that allows teams to receive GitHub pull request updates and reminders only during specified time slots to minimize distractions.
productsAndServices.name: Axolo Customizable Notification Settings and Code Review Time Slots

productsAndServices.description: A Slack bot that sends daily pull request recaps and standup notifications to keep engineering teams aligned and informed about code review progress.
productsAndServices.name: Axolo Standup Bot for Slack
